Shell websocket tests block pre-ack writes, reverify post-ack and each write, continuously reverify identity, and release controllers after malformed frames, gaps, policy reduction, and disconnect.

Control bridge and websocket tests prove exactly-once release and bounded teardown; live report proves no-takeover reacquisition and disposable named-session cleanup.
Runtime adapter, shell protocol, discovery cost, pane stream, and provider route suites exercise existing tmux authority, attach, capture, actions, and constant-cost contracts.
